name: minimal
description: Identical to standard (identity and institution/device-operator removed, UIDs reissued, descriptive text kept), except: the replacement name is a randomly generated, memorable placeholder rather than the plain subject label, and the birth date is simply replaced with the study's own scan date rather than scrambled to a nearby year. A lighter-weight alternative to standard when a distinctive, easy-to-say placeholder name is more useful than preserving an approximate age.

PatientName.note: A randomly generated placeholder name, in standard DICOM Surname^Firstname form (e.g. Abrahall^Gracious), from pydcm/names.py. Kept the same across every file for this subject, but not derived from the real name.

PatientBirthDate.note: Overrides standard's scramble_date: here the birth date is simply the study's own scan date, not an approximate real one.
